narrator.name: The Atlas narrator
narrator.voice: warm, unhurried, curious; a documentary voice that never oversells; speaks the dance's own words (names, counts) clearly
narrator.rule: The narrator only says what the profile says. Every sentence can be traced to a section, a claim or the music/movement DNA.
narrator.identity: one narrator for the whole atlas: the same face and animation everywhere; a native-speaker voice of the same character per language (studio-grade); the viewer chooses the language

scenes.title: Where and when
narration: The Progressive Double Two originated in the Dallas/Fort Worth area of Texas.
It is a regional variant of country-western dance that developed as a distinct style within the broader category of two-step dances.
on_screen: Map: United States · North America
Image 1 with attribution

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: It is a social, progressive partner dance performed in a counterclockwise circle around the dance floor.
Today it is a living tradition.
on_screen: Footage — MISSING (use images)

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: The dance uses 6- and 8-count patterns.
A basic 6-beat pattern consists of two shuffle steps (counted as 1 and 2, 3 and 4) followed by two walking steps (counted 5, 6).
The leader guides the follower through arching movements.
Watch for Arching semicircle.
on_screen: Hero video full screen, 30–45 s (7H_nkxo2-LQ)
Captions name each signature move as it appears
Formation: Progressive circle moving counterclockwise
